description: This Java source file defines the `QuotedPrintable` class, which provides a utility method for decoding quoted-printable encoded data into its original byte form, as specified in RFC 1521.

classes.name: QuotedPrintable
classes.description: A utility class that provides a method to decode quoted-printable encoded byte arrays.

methods.name: decodeQuotedPrintable
methods.description: Decodes a quoted-printable encoded byte array into the original byte array. Returns null if decoding fails.
